<b>Crustcrags</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are giant [[Crustcrawler]]s that have been bred to immense size by [[the Citadel]]'s [[Memorium]].<ref>Crustcrag [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Coral hulk with a dense shell, bred to immense size by the Citadel's Memorium."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Crustcrags walk back and forth, dealing {{Damage|2}} on contact. When [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] approaches, they charge towards her, turning around if she jumps over them.

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* Crackling, growing, stretching shell...
* Water's source... hidden... lost...
* False chambers... long teeth...
* Poison light... painful lash...
}}

== Location ==
Crustcrags can be found in the [[Sands of Karak]] section of the [[Memorium]].

== Trivia ==
* The Crustcrag's [[Needolin]] dialogue implies that they have been removed from their natural environment and treated harshly, and that they are aware, if only slightly, that the Memorium is not their true home.
